entities.name: NAS signalling connection release
entities.description: Procedure for releasing the NAS signalling connection initiated by the network. UE enters EMM-IDLE mode when RRC connection is released.

entities.name: Timer T3440
entities.description: Timer started by UE in various conditions to manage NAS signalling connection release. Upon expiry, UE locally releases NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: Timer T3444
entities.description: Timer started by UE when NAS signalling connection for eCall over IMS is released in eCall only mode.

entities.name: Timer T3445
entities.description: Timer started by UE when NAS signalling connection for HPLMN designated non-emergency MSISDN/URI is released in eCall only mode.

entities.name: Timer T3447
entities.description: SGC timer started by UE with service gap time value when NAS signalling connection for mobile originated uplink data transfer is released.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: UE state entered when RRC connection is released. NAS signalling connection is considered released.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: UE state where NAS signalling connection is active.

entities.name: EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
entities.description: UE state entered upon receipt of CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION message.

entities.name: eCall only mode
entities.description: UE configuration for eCall only mode as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102.

entities.name: SGC feature support
entities.description: Condition where UE supports SGC feature and service gap timer value is available and non-zero.

entities.name: Local release of NAS signalling connection
entities.description: UE behavior to locally release NAS signalling connection upon T3440 expiry or specific conditions.

entities.name: CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION
entities.description: Message that triggers UE to enter EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state.

relations.description: NAS signalling connection release procedure causes UE to enter EMM-IDLE state.
eCall only mode condition starts timer T3444 when eCall over IMS connection is released.
eCall only mode condition starts timer T3445 when HPLMN non-emergency connection is released.
SGC feature support condition starts timer T3447 when mobile originated uplink data connection is released.
Timer T3440 expiry establishes local release of NAS signalling connection.
CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION message requires UE to enter EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state.
Entering EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state stops timer T3440.
